47 /*
48  * Component : QSPI Flash Controller Module Registers - ALT_QSPI
49  * QSPI Flash Controller Module Registers
50  *
51  * Registers in the QSPI Flash Controller module accessible via its APB slave
52  *
53  */
54 /*
55  * Register : QSPI Configuration Register - cfg
56  *
57  * Register Layout
58  *
59  * Bits | Access | Reset | Description
60  * :--------|:-------|:------|:-------------------------------------------
61  * [0] | RW | 0x0 | QSPI Enable
62  * [1] | RW | 0x0 | Clock Polarity
63  * [2] | RW | 0x0 | Select Clock Phase
64  * [6:3] | ??? | 0x0 | *UNDEFINED*
65  * [7] | RW | 0x0 | Enable Direct Access Controller
66  * [8] | RW | 0x0 | Legacy IP Mode Enable
67  * [9] | RW | 0x0 | Peripheral select decode
68  * [13:10] | RW | 0x0 | Peripheral Chip Select Lines
69  * [14] | RW | 0x0 | Write Protect Flash Pin
70  * [15] | RW | 0x0 | Enable DMA Peripheral Interface
71  * [16] | RW | 0x0 | Enable AHB Address Re-mapping
72  * [17] | RW | 0x0 | Enter XIP Mode on next READ
73  * [18] | RW | 0x0 | Enter XIP Mode Immediately
74  * [22:19] | RW | 0xf | Master Mode Baud Rate Divisor
75  * [30:23] | ??? | 0x0 | *UNDEFINED*
76  * [31] | R | 0x0 | Serial interface and QSPI pipeline is IDLE
77  *
78  */
79 /*
80  * Field : QSPI Enable - en
81  *
82  * If this bit is disabled, the QSPI will finish the current transfer of the data
83  * word (FF_W) and stop sending. When Enabled, and qspi_n_mo_en = 0, all output
84  * enables are inactive and all pins are set to input mode.
85  *
86  * Field Enumeration Values:
87  *
88  * Enum | Value | Description
89  * :----------------------|:------|:-----------------
90  * ALT_QSPI_CFG_EN_E_DIS | 0x0 | Disable the QSPI
91  * ALT_QSPI_CFG_EN_E_EN | 0x1 | Enable the QSPI
92  *
93  * Field Access Macros:
94  *
95  */

97  * Enumerated value for register field ALT_QSPI_CFG_EN
98  *
99  * Disable the QSPI

103  * Enumerated value for register field ALT_QSPI_CFG_EN
104  *
105  * Enable the QSPI
106  */
107 #define ALT_QSPI_CFG_EN_E_EN 0x1

111 /* The Most Significant Bit (MSB) position of the ALT_QSPI_CFG_EN register field. */

113 /* The width in bits of the ALT_QSPI_CFG_EN register field. */

265 /*
266  * Field : Legacy IP Mode Enable - enlegacyip
267  *
268  * This bit can select the Direct Access Controller/Indirect Access Controller or
269  * legacy mode.If legacy mode is selected, any write to the controller via the AHB
270  * interface is serialized and sent to the FLASH device. Any valid AHB read will
271  * pop the internal RX-FIFO, retrieving data that was forwarded by the external
272  * FLASH device on the SPI lines, byte transfers of 4, 2 or 1 are permitted and
273  * controlled via the HSIZE input.
274  *
275  * Field Enumeration Values:
276  *
277  * Enum | Value | Description
278  * :---------------------------------|:------|:--------------------------------------
279  * ALT_QSPI_CFG_ENLEGACYIP_E_LEGMOD | 0x1 | Legacy Mode
280  * ALT_QSPI_CFG_ENLEGACYIP_E_DIMOD | 0x0 | Use Direct/Indirect Access Controller
281  *
282  * Field Access Macros:
283  *
284  */

286  * Enumerated value for register field ALT_QSPI_CFG_ENLEGACYIP

288  * Legacy Mode
289  */
290 #define ALT_QSPI_CFG_ENLEGACYIP_E_LEGMOD 0x1
291 /*
292  * Enumerated value for register field ALT_QSPI_CFG_ENLEGACYIP

295  */
296 #define ALT_QSPI_CFG_ENLEGACYIP_E_DIMOD 0x0
